description: Photovoltaic Power Generation: Multidimensional Indicators, Forecasting, Optimization and Carbon Assessment is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Pengying Fan, Zhenlin Chen. Data and exploratory analysis materials accompanying a multidimensional study of photovoltaic power generation. The archive links indicator construction and data-quality checks with power-production forecasting, particle-swarm planning optimization, and scenario-based carbon assessment. It includes tabular inputs and Python/MATLAB scripts for preprocessing, distributional diagnostics, dimensionality reduction, regression, visualization, and optimization. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is OTHER-CLOSED. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
